How to Submit Public Comment:

Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of the following
methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the City Clerk
prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person per item. At the Mayor’
s discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to address the City Council.

Electronic submission of Public Comment is also available via the City’s website or by email as noted
below. Public Comment submitted electronically will be read into the record. Words that would disrupt
the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language, will not be read. Your
comments must be received by 5:00 P.M. on meeting day.

Website: Please submit your comments using our online public comment form at Public Comment.

Watch the Meeting Online

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  AND COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

  The City solicited applications for the Civil Service Commission and Community
  Services Commission with terms ending May 31, 2023. The Council is requested to
  interview the applicants and consider appointments to the Commissions.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council appoint Commissioners upon conclusion
  of the interviews and select individuals they would like to add to the waitlist should
  any vacancies arise during the unexpired term.

  3. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 2, 2023, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter. Materials related to an item on this Agenda,
submitted to the City Council after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on the
City website.
Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of the Americans
with Disabilities Act of 1990.
Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting must
notify the City Clerk Department at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting.

MINUTES OF APRIL 27, 2023

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Harrington called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at

  5:31 P.M. on Thursday, April 27, 2023, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South

  Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Eric Chan, Tony Ding, Vice Mayor John Wu, and Mayor

  John R. Harrington .

  Council Members Absent:  Denise Menchaca.

  Staff Members Present:  City  Manager  Mark  Lazzaretto,  Community  Services

  Director  Rebecca  Perez,  Human  Resources/ Rick

  Management  Director  Edward  Macias,  and  Assistant

  City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

I  Assistant City Clerk Bonus provided information for the public on how to view the meeting

  and how to request meeting agendas, and announced that due to the inability to have

  the full Council present, with the Mayor' s approval, deliberation and appointments had

  been moved to the May 2, 2023, regular City Council meeting.

  1.  PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

  2.  INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION AND

  COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

  Interviews of the following applicants were conducted:

  Civil Service Commission

  Douglas Richter ( Not Interviewed)

  George Carney

  Howard Fong

  Community Services Commission

I  Davis Barrantes

  Gary Liu
  Mengshi Fu ( Not Interviewed)

  Nancy Duong
  Therese Liu ( Not Interviewed)

  Ting Xie

  Appointments were deferred to the May 2, 2023, regular City Council meeting.
